summary: Regression test of the two HIGH-priority bugs from iteration_14 (new-client _id leak on passwordless auth, and missing publicAPI.getOrganization causing business info to error). Both HIGH bugs are FIXED and verified end-to-end via curl + Playwright. Customer Portal now completes the full new-client E2E: phone+name entry -> 200 client creation -> logged-in dashboard with client name, phone, visit counter, appointment history, business-info card, and 'Reservar Nueva Cita' CTA. The MEDIUM 'two 401 on load' from iteration_14 is still present but is benign (from global AuthContext /api/auth/me probe for manager/owner session) and does NOT block the portal flow.
passed: POST /api/public/auth/passwordless (new client with phone+name+org) -> 200 with clean client object, NO _id field leaked (HIGH bug from iter_14 FIXED)
POST /api/public/auth/passwordless (existing client) -> 200 status=existing with client payload
GET /api/public/org_demo001/organization -> 200 with {organization_id, name: 'Demo Org', owner_id, created_at} (new route works, HIGH bug FIXED)
Frontend /portal/org_demo001 loads, renders phone-login form and shows business name 'Demo Org' in header (business info now loads without error toast)

Full E2E new-client via UI: unique +57 phone + name 'Regression NewClient' -> welcome toast '¡Bienvenido, ... Tu cuenta ha sido creada.' -> dashboard rendered with 'Mi Cuenta', client name, phone, Total de Visitas 0, 'Reservar Nueva Cita' button, 'Información del Negocio' card, and 'Historial de Citas' empty-state with 'Reservar Primera Cita'
No 'Error al cargar información del negocio' toast on portal load (previous HIGH bug fixed)

failed.issue: Two 401 responses on GET /api/auth/me still fire on initial portal page load (before any user action). These originate from the global AuthContext probing for an existing manager/owner session and are not portal-specific. Cosmetic (visible in console) but does not surface to the user or block the passwordless flow.
failed.evidence: Console: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401' x2 on GET /portal/org_demo001. No user-facing error. Portal renders and works correctly.

action_items: Optional: silence the two /api/auth/me 401s on public /portal/:orgId pages by skipping the AuthContext session probe on public routes, OR by treating 401 as expected/anonymous instead of logging as error. Non-blocking - defer to full testing pass.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested happy path (login + new-client E2E + dashboard render). Marketing UI + Reservar Nueva Cita -> /book navigation not re-clicked due to a Playwright phone-widget entry quirk on the second run, but the underlying route+button are present and iteration_13 previously verified /book flow works.
